preparation.initial_method: periodic Voronoi of a 4x4 square grid with uniform [-.25,.25] jitter; identical initial coordinates and topology for each p0; fixed-topology minimization

protocol.noise_initialization: zero; driving and step start together
protocol.noise_labels: independent OU fields on unordered cell pairs, evolving also while non-contacting
protocol.T1_rule: geometric threshold, perpendicular new edge; reject invalid polygons; do not impose monotone total energy
